caption: The drawing depicts a single, detailed teapot centered on a plain, light-colored background. The teapot has a rounded, bulbous body with a short, circular base. It features a long, curved spout on the left side, decorated with subtle patterns near its base, and an ornate handle on the right, also adorned with intricate designs. The lid is dome-shaped, topped with a knob, and has a slightly wavy, flared rim. The teapot is rendered in black and white, using fine pencil shading to create texture and suggest reflective surfaces and volume. A rectangular border frames the drawing, and the name "W.W. Jennings" appears in the lower right corner. The background contains light smudges and small stains, but no other objects are present.
title: Silver Teapot
